game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Variable Crates: Drag collected grain sacks into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the signal beacon.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Drag collected grain sacks into labelled variable crates, then read each crate's value to feed the signal beacon. Each round, a new grain sacks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the crate_b value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 290 points of grain sacks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 9 (extended tier): Variable Crates
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Variable Crates' (Week 1 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how crate_b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
